description: Each record is evaluated alone (--evidence <file>) against policy.json as both current and measured policy and matrix.json with --candidate-commit 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567. Every case must exit 1 and its stderr-free JSON errors must contain the fragment.

cases.candidate-added-device.json: is not in the protected device allowlist
cases.wrong-workflow-sha.json: does not match the pinned default-branch signer workflow SHA
cases.wrong-workflow-ref.json: is not a trusted default-branch signer workflow
cases.untrusted-collector.json: collector sha256 does not match the trusted default-branch digest
cases.stale-candidate.json: is not the commit under evaluation
cases.wrong-snapshot.json: support snapshot digest does not match the support matrix under evaluation
cases.bundle-subject-mismatch.json: no in-toto subject digest matches sha256 of the evidence file
